channel.title: Privet SIM — Guides
channel.description: How travel eSIMs work: installation, phone compatibility, paying from Russia.

item.title: What is an eSIM and how it works when you travel
item.description: A simple explanation: what an eSIM is, why it beats roaming and a local SIM card, how to install it before your trip and what happens to your main number.

item.title: How to check if your phone supports eSIM
item.description: Three ways to check eSIM support on iPhone and Android: the *#06# code, settings and the list of models. Plus how to tell whether your phone is carrier-locked.

item.title: How to install an eSIM on Android
item.description: Step-by-step eSIM installation on Samsung, Google Pixel and Xiaomi with a QR code or manually, mobile data and roaming setup, and what to do if the internet does not work.

item.title: How to pay for a travel eSIM with a Russian card
item.description: How to buy a travel eSIM when foreign services do not accept Russian cards: pay via SBP from any bank app, in USDT or from your balance, with prices in rubles.
